title: Organophosphate flame retardant TDCPP: A risk factor for renal cancer?
authors: Zhou, Xuan; Zhou, Xiang; Yao, Liangyu; Zhang, Xu; Cong, Rong; Luan, Jiaochen; Zhang, Tongtong; Song, Ninghong
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接预测TDCPP与肾癌相关基因及转录因子的结合，但核心是毒物-肿瘤关联而非TF-DNA互作机制，方法仅简单对接，深度不足。
abstract: Tris (1,3-dichloro-2-propyl) phosphate (TDCPP), a chlorinated organophosphate flame retardants(OPFRs), is widely used in a range of plastic foams, resins, and latexes. It can be detected in human tissues, including urine, and milk. Recent research has suggested that TDCPP has neurotoxic, reproductive, and potentially carcinogenic. In our study, we proposed a novel method for predicting the gene associated with tumor-compound interactions. We firstly used The Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD) and downloaded potentially interactive genes about TDCPP in renal carcinoma. Gene expression data and the corresponding clinical information of the Kidney renal clear cell cancer (KIRC) patients were obtained from The Cancer Genome Atlas database (TCGA). Data from normal people in The Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) databases was used to supplement the calculations. After being predicted by PharmMapper database, and validated by Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, 25 genes were selected to construct protein-protein interaction network analysis. The prognostic value of these genes was evaluated with Kaplan-Meier analysis, and four interactive genes were selected. Gene set variation analysis and drug-target binding prediction proved the hub gene has a potential relationship with renal clear cell carcinoma. We then used the ChEA3 (Chip-X Enrichment Analysis, Version 3) database to predict the upstream of these interactive genes. Molecular docking was used to predict the binding of these transcription factors to TDCPP and interactive genes to TDCPP. Moreover, in cell lines and in vivo experiments demonstrated the cancer-promoting effect of TDCPP. The expression of the interactive genes was verified by qPCR and Western blot. Combining binding energy and qPCR results, we choose EPAS1 to verify its function in renal carcinoma cell lines. Our study provides a novel method to predict the potential interactive genes between TDCPP and renal cancer, which may reveal potential targets for the treatment and prevention of diseases.
abstract_zh: 磷酸三(1,3-二氯-2-丙基)酯 (TDCPP) 是一种氯化有机磷酸酯阻燃剂 (OPFRs)，广泛用于多种塑料泡沫、树脂和乳胶中。它可在人体组织中被检测到，包括尿液和乳汁。近期研究表明，TDCPP 具有神经毒性、生殖毒性，并可能具有致癌性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种预测与肿瘤-化合物相互作用相关基因的新方法。我们首先利用比较毒物基因组学数据库 (CTD)，下载了关于 TDCPP 在肾癌中可能相互作用的基因。基因表达数据及相应的肾透明细胞癌 (KIRC) 患者临床信息来自癌症基因组图谱数据库 (TCGA)。来自基因型-组织表达 (GTEx) 数据库中正常人群的数据用于补充计算。经 PharmMapper 数据库预测，并通过基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书验证后，筛选出 25 个基因用于构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析。通过 Kaplan-Meier 分析评估这些基因的预后价值，并选出 4 个相互作用基因。基因集变异分析和药物-靶点结合预测证明，核心基因与肾透明细胞癌存在潜在关联。随后，我们使用 ChEA3（Chip-X 富集分析，版本 3）数据库预测这些相互作用基因的上游调控因子。分子对接用于预测这些转录因子与 TDCPP 以及相互作用基因与 TDCPP 的结合情况。此外，细胞系和体内实验证明了 TDCPP 的促癌作用。通过 qPCR 和 Western blot 验证了相互作用基因的表达。结合结合能和 qPCR 结果，我们选择 EPAS1 在肾癌细胞系中验证其功能。我们的研究提供了一种预测 TDCPP 与肾癌之间潜在相互作用基因的新方法，这可能揭示疾病治疗和预防的潜在靶点。
